era: Mature surface civilization; absolute date deliberately unresolved
notes: The terrain, person, materials, beliefs and positions are working scenography, not settled biological or geological canon. Alchul is never modeled as a visible object.

outside.title: Outside observer
outside.explanation: Inspect material structure, geometry, river margin and provisional anatomy. No camera can directly expose the inhabitants' private sensory life.

resident.title: Resident interpretation
resident.explanation: A place matters through movement, stable routes, shared air, substrate response, kin responsibilities and prior experiments. This is a translation, not simulated dinosaur vision.

contact.title: Contact testimony (unclosed)
contact.explanation: Witnesses report familiar places in other conditions. Ordinary inferences and genuine anomalies remain in dispute. The model does not depict Alchul's body, mind or perspective.

lenses.outside: Wood and stone elements form a riverbank observation platform. This is a demonstration of environmental testing, not a real excavated Cretaceous structure.
lenses.resident: An altered sound through a braced stave may be the first warning that the ground is not as stable as the last return. A second reader must test the claim.
lenses.contact: The ordinary change in flow can be measured. No anomalous report is required to explain it, though testimony sometimes changes which tests are attempted.

lenses.outside: A proposed protected shelf and broad approach. No exact incubation temperature, clutch size, shell chemistry or gestation organ is represented.
lenses.resident: The route must remain usable by a vulnerable or egg-bearing adult; shared clean air and the right to refuse entry matter more than a symmetrical doorway.
lenses.contact: Contact-linked testimony does not override independently verified nursery air, water, exit or reproductive safety procedures.

lenses.outside: A controlled organic-processing area illustrates fermented plant material as a material resource, not a supernatural substance.
lenses.resident: Repeated returns, cultivation, teaching and risk change what this place means. Chemical work and ritual can occupy the same ground.
lenses.contact: Some altered-state reports arise in Harvest-related conditions. Fermentation is natural; the ontology of Alchul remains unresolved.

lenses.outside: Simple stone markers separate independent observations. No object here represents the shape or intention of Alchul.
lenses.resident: An unusual report can be retained without forcing the community to accept its interpretation. Disagreement and repeatable tests protect shared decisions.
lenses.contact: Accounts of the same place in different times or conditions are preserved as testimony, not shown as certain predictions or Alchul's point of view.
